items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-10-21
items.q: you see Ray or Paiso or the other person where you see them, they keep all that. But we all, we don't worry about that.

ctx.x: I'd like to talk to some of those guys from the society who helped to choose the band, you know, and stuff. If you can get any of them's names or addresses.

But I tell you, the best way you can get there, you see Ray or Paiso or the other person where you see them, they keep all that. But we all, we don't worry about that. We just worry about the guy's job. If you call the upteller, you meet, see the person even going on. But otherwise, we don't worry about it, see.
Well, let's see. Back to what goes on in the church. You got offerings, singing, and the preachers get up and preach.
